name: deck_equip_loot_twin_cap
description: Loot-vs-loot identity cap (docs/loot.md §34, docs/enemies_ranking.md §4.8): two IRON RING loot twins (derived id 164) owned under one uncapped row, with no curated ring in the collection. Decking the first copy succeeds; the second is refused because the cap (1) travels with the card identity and resolves from the curated catalog -- the twin cannot double-deck past max_copies through its own id. Pre-fix deck_ident_cmp returned cap 0 for loot-vs-loot and both copies decked.
